title: The Cursed Coin
text: A gold coin lies on the road, face up, bright as the sun, without a speck of dust on it. The face on it is no king you know, and it is smiling. Everyone knows the stories about coins like this. Everyone wants it anyway.

options.label: The Leader pockets the smiling coin, whatever the stories say.

outcomes.text: It is just a coin. A very nice one. Probably.
It is not just a coin. It is warm, and it is smiling wider.

options.label: Kick it into the ditch, and walk on before temptation wins.

outcomes.text: It rolls back onto the road behind you, face up, smiling, and follows you for a while.

options.label: The most devout blesses it before anyone touches it, to drive out whatever smiles.

outcomes.text: It goes dull, and stops smiling, and stays gold.
